== Summary ==
Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 54: the slip of [[Katana (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014), cropped at 300 dpi. It prints errata version PC-E3 (“May add 3 pilots, 6 passengers, and 4 TIEs. Your other Dreadnaughts here are power +1, forfeit +2, Heroic, and immune to attrition < 4. Permanent pilot provides ability of 3. Immune to attrition < 4.”).<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Not an official image file.''' Crop made 11 November 2026 for batch C2/C3 (swccg-guild/work#236). Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
